name: ProcessFile.rexx
runtimeDependencies: MultiView for text, guides and images
notes: The DefIcons44 Aminet archive preserves the original 2.1.12 script. The development source keeps the installed path Rexxc/Processfile.rexx.

Stock startup starts RexxMast and adds SYS:Rexxc to the command path. Invoke the installed script through RX. TXT and GUIDE dispatch to MultiView. HTML passes the file to C:OpenURL and returns its status.
Rexxc is shared with the existing AmigaOS and EjectADF scripts. Default icons and DoMIME keep their separate ownership.
